svg.title: Testing the toolkit by hand
svg.desc: An animation, close up and seen from above, of the Lesson 2-7 activity. A stretch of the circle's tape runs up the picture, with the short cross strip across it near the top. With the motors off, the robot is slid by hand to four positions while a panel shows what test_sensors() prints. On the line, each sensor sits on an edge of the tape and reads about 0.5: on line True, cross False. Off to one side, only the left sensor is on the tape: left 0.80, right 0.20, error +0.60, on line True, cross False. Completely off the line, both read 0.20: both False. Then it is slid along the line to the cross: cross stays False until both sensors are on the strip, where both read 0.80 and both answers are True.
